q.en: Who wrote the second letter of John to the elect lady?
To whom did the elder write his letter?

a.en: The elect lady and her children

q.en: In what did the elder love the elect lady and her children?
Who else loved the lady and her children besides the elder?

a.en: All who have known the truth

q.en: What dwells in us and shall be with us for ever?
q.ml: നമ്മിൽ വസിക്കുകയും എന്നേക്കും നമ്മോടുകൂടെ ഇരിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നതു എന്ത്?

q.en: For how long shall the truth be with us?
What three things did John wish for the lady and her children?
q.ta: யோவான் அம்மாளுக்கு வாழ்த்தியது என்னென்ன மூன்று காரியங்கள்?

q.en: From whom come grace, mercy and peace?

a.en: God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

q.en: Whose Son is the Lord Jesus Christ?
With what two things do grace, mercy and peace come?
q.ml: കൃപയും കനിവും സമാധാനവും ഏതു രണ്ടിലൂടെ വരും?

q.en: How did John feel when he found some of her children walking in truth?
q.ta: பிள்ளைகளில் சிலர் சத்தியத்தில் நடப்பதைக் கண்டு யோவான் எப்படி உணர்ந்தார்?
q.ml: മക്കളിൽ ചിലർ സത്യത്തിൽ നടക്കുന്നതു കണ്ടു യോഹന്നാൻ എങ്ങനെ ആയി?

q.en: In what were some of the lady's children walking?
From whom have we received a commandment to walk in truth?
q.ta: சத்தியத்தில் நடக்கும் கற்பனையை நாம் யாரிடமிருந்து பெற்றோம்?
q.ml: സത്യത്തിൽ നടക്കാനുള്ള കല്പന നമുക്കു ആരിൽനിന്നു ലഭിച്ചു?

q.en: What did John beseech the lady that we do?
Was the commandment to love one another a new commandment?

a.en: No, it was from the beginning

q.en: Since when have we had the commandment to love one another?
q.ml: അന്യോന്യം സ്നേഹിക്കുന്ന കല്പന എപ്പോൾ മുതൽ നമുക്കുണ്ടു?

q.en: What is love, according to John?
What commandment have we heard from the beginning?
Who have entered into the world?
What do the deceivers not confess?

a.en: That Jesus Christ is come in the flesh

q.en: What two names does John give to one who does not confess Christ come in the flesh?
q.ta: இயேசு மாம்சத்தில் வந்ததை அறிக்கைபண்ணாதவனுக்கு யோவான் இடும் இரண்டு பெயர்கள் என்ன?
q.ml: യേശു ജഡത്തിൽ വന്നതു സ്വീകരിക്കാത്തവന്നു യോഹന്നാൻ നല്കുന്ന രണ്ടു പേരുകൾ ഏവ?

q.en: What should we look to, so that we lose not what we have wrought?
q.ta: நாம் செய்தவற்றை இழக்காதபடி எதைக் குறித்து எச்சரிக்கையாயிருக்கவேண்டும்?

q.en: What do we receive if we take heed to ourselves?
Whose doctrine must we abide in?
Who does not have God?

a.en: Whoever transgresses and abides not in Christ's doctrine

q.en: Whom does he have who abides in the doctrine of Christ?

a.en: Both the Father and the Son

q.en: Where should we not receive one who does not bring the doctrine of Christ?
What must we not bid one who brings not this doctrine?
Of what is he partaker who bids God speed to such a person?
With what did John not want to write his many things?
q.ta: யோவான் அநேக காரியங்களை எதினால் எழுத மனதில்லாதிருந்தார்?

q.en: How did John hope to speak to them?
Why did John hope to come and speak face to face?
q.ta: யோவான் ஏன் நேரில் வந்து பேச விரும்பினார்?
q.ml: യോഹന്നാൻ എന്തിനാണു നേരിൽ വന്നു സംസാരിപ്പാൻ ആശിച്ചതു?

a.en: That their joy may be full

q.en: Who greet the lady in the end of the letter?

a.en: The children of her elect sister
